38.text: Jesus turned, and beheld them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? And they said unto him, Rabbi (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), where abidest thou?

39.text: He saith unto them, Come, and ye shall see. They came therefore and saw where he abode; and they abode with him that day: it was about the tenth hour.

42.text: He brought him unto Jesus. Jesus looked upon him, and said, Thou art Simon the son of John: thou shalt be called Cephas (which is by interpretation, Peter).

43.text: On the morrow he was minded to go forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philip: and Jesus saith unto him, Follow me.

47.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

48.text: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

50.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee underneath the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

51.text: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye shall see the heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

4.text: And Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

7.text: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

8.text: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the ruler of the feast. And they bare it.

16.text: and to them that sold the doves he said, Take these things hence; make not my Father’s house a house of merchandise.

19.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

3.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except one be born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

5.text: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except one be born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

6.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

7.text: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born anew.

8.text: The wind bloweth where it will, and thou hearest the voice thereof, but knowest not whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

10.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou the teacher of Israel, and understandest not these things?

11.text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that which we know, and bear witness of that which we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

12.text: If I told you earthly things and ye believe not, how shall ye believe if I tell you heavenly things?

13.text: And no one hath ascended into heaven, but he that descended out of heaven, even the Son of man, who is in heaven.

14.text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up;

15.text: that whosoever believeth may in him have eternal life.

16.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth on him should not perish, but have eternal life.

17.text: For God sent not the Son into the world to judge the world; but that the world should be saved through him.

18.text: He that believeth on him is not judged: he that believeth not hath been judged already, because he hath not believed on the name of the only begotten Son of God.

19.text: And this is the judgment, that the light is come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

20.text: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, and cometh not to the light, lest his works should be reproved.

21.text: But he that doeth the truth cometh to the light, that his works may be made manifest, that they have been wrought in God.

7.text: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

10.text: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

13.text: Jesus answered and said unto her, Every one that drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

14.text: but whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall become in him a well of water springing up unto eternal life.

16.text: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

17.text: The woman answered and said unto him, I have no husband. Jesus saith unto her, Thou saidst well, I have no husband:

18.text: for thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: this hast thou said truly.

21.text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father.

22.text: Ye worship that which ye know not: we worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

23.text: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and truth: for such doth the Father seek to be his worshippers.

24.text: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

26.text: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

32.text: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not.

34.text: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to accomplish his work.

35.text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh the harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields, that they are white already unto harvest.

36.text: He that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal; that he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

37.text: For herein is the saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

38.text: I sent you to reap that whereon ye have not labored: others have labored, and ye are entered into their labor.

48.text: Jesus therefore said unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will in no wise believe.

50.text: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. The man believed the word that Jesus spake unto him, and he went his way.

53.text: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

6.text: When Jesus saw him lying, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wouldest thou be made whole?

8.text: Jesus saith unto him, Arise, take up thy bed, and walk.

14.text: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing befall thee.

17.text: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh even until now, and I work.

19.text: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father doing: for what things soever he doeth, these the Son also doeth in like manner.

20.text: For the Father loveth the Son, and showeth him all things that himself doeth: and greater works than these will he show him, that ye may marvel.

21.text: For as the Father raiseth the dead and giveth them life, even so the Son also giveth life to whom he will.

22.text: For neither doth the Father judge any man, but he hath given all judgment unto the Son;

23.text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He that honoreth not the Son honoreth not the Father that sent him.

24.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth him that sent me, hath eternal life, and cometh not into judgment, but hath passed out of death into life.

25.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour cometh, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God; and they that hear shall live.

26.text: For as the Father hath life in himself, even so gave he to the Son also to have life in himself:

27.text: and he gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

28.text: Marvel not at this: for the hour cometh, in which all that are in the tombs shall hear his voice,

29.text: and shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of judgment.

30.text: I can of myself do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is righteous; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

31.text: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

32.text: It is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

33.text: Ye have sent unto John, and he hath borne witness unto the truth.

34.text: But the witness which I receive is not from man: howbeit I say these things, that ye may be saved.

35.text: He was the lamp that burneth and shineth; and ye were willing to rejoice for a season in his light.

36.text: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father hath given me to accomplish, the very works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

37.text: And the Father that sent me, he hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

38.text: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he sent, him ye believe not.

39.text: Ye search the scriptures, because ye think that in them ye have eternal life; and these are they which bear witness of me;

40.text: and ye will not come to me, that ye may have life.

41.text: I receive not glory from men.

42.text: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in yourselves.

43.text: I am come in my Father’s name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

44.text: How can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and the glory that cometh from the only God ye seek not?

45.text: Think not that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, on whom ye have set your hope.

46.text: For if ye believed Moses, ye would believe me; for he wrote of me.

47.text: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

5.text: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude cometh unto him, saith unto Philip, Whence are we to buy bread, that these may eat?

10.text: Jesus said, Make the people sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

12.text: And when they were filled, he saith unto his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which remain over, that nothing be lost.

20.text: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

26.text: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye ate of the loaves, and were filled.

27.text: Work not for the food which perisheth, but for the food which abideth unto eternal life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him the Father, even God, hath sealed.

29.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

32.text: Jesus therefore said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, It was not Moses that gave you the bread out of heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread out of heaven.

33.text: For the bread of God is that which cometh down out of heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

35.text: Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall not hunger, and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

36.text: But I said unto you, that ye have seen me, and yet believe not.

37.text: All that which the Father giveth me shall come unto me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

38.text: For I am come down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

39.text: And this is the will of him that sent me, that of all that which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.

40.text: For this is the will of my Father, that every one that beholdeth the Son, and believeth on him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

43.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

44.text: No man can come to me, except the Father that sent me draw him: and I will raise him up in the last day.

45.text: It is written in the prophets, And they shall all be taught of God. Every one that hath heard from the Father, and hath learned, cometh unto me.

46.text: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he that is from God, he hath seen the Father.

47.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth hath eternal life.

48.text: I am the bread of life.

49.text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

50.text: This is the bread which cometh down out of heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

51.text: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: yea and the bread which I will give is my flesh, for the life of the world.

53.text: Jesus therefore said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man and drink his blood, ye have not life in yourselves.

54.text: He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

55.text: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

56.text: He that eateth my flesh and drinketh my blood abideth in me, and I in him.

57.text: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he that eateth me, he also shall live because of me.

58.text: This is the bread which came down out of heaven: not as the fathers ate, and died; he that eateth this bread shall live for ever.

61.text: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said unto them, Doth this cause you to stumble?

62.text: What then if ye should behold the Son of man ascending where he was before?

63.text: It is the spirit that giveth life; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I have spoken unto you are spirit, and are life.

64.text: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who it was that should betray him.

65.text: And he said, For this cause have I said unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it be given unto him of the Father.

67.text: Jesus said therefore unto the twelve, Would ye also go away?

70.text: Jesus answered them, Did not I choose you the twelve, and one of you is a devil?

6.text: Jesus therefore saith unto them, My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.

7.text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that its works are evil.

8.text: Go ye up unto the feast: I go not up unto this feast; because my time is not yet fulfilled.

16.text: Jesus therefore answered them, and said, My teaching is not mine, but his that sent me.

17.text: If any man willeth to do his will, he shall know of the teaching, whether it is of God, or whether I speak from myself.

18.text: He that speaketh from himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh the glory of him that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

19.text: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you doeth the law? Why seek ye to kill me?

21.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, I did one work, and ye all marvel because thereof.

22.text: Moses hath given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers); and on the sabbath ye circumcise a man.

23.text: If a man receiveth circumcision on the sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken; are ye wroth with me, because I made a man every whit whole on the sabbath?

24.text: Judge not according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

28.text: Jesus therefore cried in the temple, teaching and saying, Ye both know me, and know whence I am; and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

29.text: I know him; because I am from him, and he sent me.

33.text: Jesus therefore said, Yet a little while am I with you, and I go unto him that sent me.

34.text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, ye cannot come.

37.text: Now on the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me and drink.

38.text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, from within him shall flow rivers of living water.

12.text: Again therefore Jesus spake unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.

21.text: He said therefore again unto them, I go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin: whither I go, ye cannot come.

23.text: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

24.text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for except ye believe that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

28.text: Jesus therefore said, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself, but as the Father taught me, I speak these things.

31.text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews that had believed him, If ye abide in my word, then are ye truly my disciples;

32.text: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

34.text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Every one that committeth sin is the bondservant of sin.

36.text: If therefore the Son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

51.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my word, he shall never see death.

56.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it, and was glad.

58.text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was born, I am.

3.text: Jesus answered, Neither did this man sin, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

4.text: We must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

5.text: When I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

7.text: and said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam (which is by interpretation, Sent). He went away therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

35.text: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and finding him, he said, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

37.text: Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and he it is that speaketh with thee.

39.text: And Jesus said, For judgment came I into this world, that they that see not may see; and that they that see may become blind.

41.text: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye would have no sin: but now ye say, We see: your sin remaineth.

1.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the fold of the sheep, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

2.text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

3.text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

4.text: When he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

5.text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

7.text: Jesus therefore said unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

8.text: All that came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

9.text: I am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.

10.text: The thief cometh not, but that he may steal, and kill, and destroy: I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

11.text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd layeth down his life for the sheep.

12.text: He that is a hireling, and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, beholdeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth, and the wolf snatcheth them, and scattereth them:

13.text: he fleeth because he is a hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

14.text: I am the good shepherd; and I know mine own, and mine own know me,

15.text: even as the Father knoweth me, and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.

16.text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and they shall become one flock, one shepherd.

17.text: Therefore doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

18.text: No one taketh it away from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment received I from my Father.

25.text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believe not: the works that I do in my Father’s name, these bear witness of me.

26.text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.

27.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

28.text: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.

29.text: My Father, who hath given them unto me, is greater than all; and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father’s hand.

30.text: I and the Father are one.

32.text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I showed you from the Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

34.text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

35.text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came (and the scripture cannot be broken),

36.text: say ye of him, whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

37.text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

38.text: But if I do them, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.

4.text: But when Jesus heard it, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified thereby.

7.text: Then after this he saith to the disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.

9.text: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If a man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

10.text: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because the light is not in him.

11.text: These things spake he: and after this he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus is fallen asleep; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

14.text: Then Jesus therefore said unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

15.text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

23.text: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

25.text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth on me, though he die, yet shall he live;

26.text: and whosoever liveth and believeth on me shall never die. Believest thou this?

34.text: and said, Where have ye laid him? They say unto him, Lord, come and see.

39.text: Jesus saith, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time the body decayeth; for he hath been dead four days.

40.text: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou believedst, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

41.text: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou heardest me.

42.text: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the multitude that standeth around I said it, that they may believe that thou didst send me.

43.text: And when he had thus spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

44.text: He that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with grave-clothes; and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

7.text: Jesus therefore said, Suffer her to keep it against the day of my burying.

8.text: For the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.

23.text: And Jesus answereth them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

24.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit.

25.text: He that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

26.text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will the Father honor.

27.text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But for this cause came I unto this hour.

28.text: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

30.text: Jesus answered and said, This voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.

31.text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

32.text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.

35.text: Jesus therefore said unto them, Yet a little while is the light among you. Walk while ye have the light, that darkness overtake you not: and he that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

36.text: While ye have the light, believe on the light, that ye may become sons of light. These things spake Jesus, and he departed and hid himself from them.

44.text: And Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

45.text: And he that beholdeth me beholdeth him that sent me.

46.text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me may not abide in the darkness.

47.text: And if any man hear my sayings, and keep them not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

48.text: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my sayings, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I spake, the same shall judge him in the last day.

49.text: For I spake not from myself; but the Father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

50.text: And I know that his commandment is life eternal; the things therefore which I speak, even as the Father hath said unto me, so I speak.

7.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt understand hereafter.

8.text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

10.text: Jesus saith to him, He that is bathed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

11.text: For he knew him that should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

12.text: So when he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and sat down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

13.text: Ye call me, Teacher, and, Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

14.text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

15.text: For I have given you an example, that ye also should do as I have done to you.

16.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord; neither one that is sent greater than he that sent him.

17.text: If ye know these things, blessed are ye if ye do them.

18.text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth my bread lifted up his heel against me.

19.text: From henceforth I tell you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

20.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

21.text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in the spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

26.text: Jesus therefore answereth, He it is, for whom I shall dip the sop, and give it him. So when he had dipped the sop, he taketh and giveth it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

27.text: And after the sop, then entered Satan into him. Jesus therefore saith unto him, What thou doest, do quickly.

31.text: When therefore he was gone out, Jesus saith, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him;

32.text: and God shall glorify him in himself, and straightway shall he glorify him.

33.text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say unto you.

34.text: A new commandment I give unto you, that ye love one another; even as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

35.text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

36.text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow afterwards.

38.text: Jesus answereth, Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

1.text: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, believe also in me.

2.text: In my Father’s house are many mansions; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.

3.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again, and will receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

4.text: And whither I go, ye know the way.

6.text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life: no one cometh unto the Father, but by me.

7.text: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

9.text: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and dost thou not know me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; how sayest thou, Show us the Father?

10.text: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I say unto you I speak not from myself: but the Father abiding in me doeth his works.

11.text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

12.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto the Father.

13.text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.text: If ye shall ask anything in my name, that will I do.

15.text: If ye love me, ye will keep my commandments.

16.text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,

17.text: even the Spirit of truth: whom the world cannot receive; for it beholdeth him not, neither knoweth him: ye know him; for he abideth with you, and shall be in you.

18.text: I will not leave you desolate: I come unto you.

19.text: Yet a little while, and the world beholdeth me no more; but ye behold me: because I live, ye shall live also.

20.text: In that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

21.text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself unto him.

23.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my word: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

24.text: He that loveth me not keepeth not my words: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

25.text: These things have I spoken unto you, while yet abiding with you.

26.text: But the Comforter, even the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said unto you.

27.text: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

28.text: Ye heard how I said to you, I go away, and I come unto you. If ye loved me, ye would have rejoiced, because I go unto the Father: for the Father is greater than I.

29.text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe.

30.text: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world cometh: and he hath nothing in me;

31.text: but that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

1.text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

2.text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit, he taketh it away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he cleanseth it, that it may bear more fruit.

3.text: Already ye are clean because of the word which I have spoken unto you.

4.text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me.

5.text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruit: for apart from me ye can do nothing.

6.text: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

7.text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

8.text: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and so shall ye be my disciples.

9.text: Even as the Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in my love.

10.text: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.

11.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be made full.

12.text: This is my commandment, that ye love one another, even as I have loved you.

13.text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

14.text: Ye are my friends, if ye do the things which I command you.

15.text: No longer do I call you servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I heard from my Father I have made known unto you.

16.text: Ye did not choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that ye should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should abide: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

17.text: These things I command you, that ye may love one another.

18.text: If the world hateth you, ye know that it hath hated me before it hated you.

19.text: If ye were of the world, the world would love its own: but because ye are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

20.text: Remember the word that I said unto you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

21.text: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.

22.text: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no excuse for their sin.

23.text: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

24.text: If I had not done among them the works which none other did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

25.text: But this cometh to pass, that the word may be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

26.text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall bear witness of me:

27.text: and ye also bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

1.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be caused to stumble.

2.text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the hour cometh, that whosoever killeth you shall think that he offereth service unto God.

3.text: And these things will they do, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

4.text: But these things have I spoken unto you, that when their hour is come, ye may remember them, how that I told you. And these things I said not unto you from the beginning, because I was with you.

5.text: But now I go unto him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

6.text: But because I have spoken these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

7.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is expedient for you that I go away; for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I go, I will send him unto you.

8.text: And he, when he is come, will convict the world in respect of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

9.text: of sin, because they believe not on me;

10.text: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and ye behold me no more;

11.text: of judgment, because the prince of this world hath been judged.

12.text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

13.text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he shall guide you into all the truth: for he shall not speak from himself; but what things soever he shall hear, these shall he speak: and he shall declare unto you the things that are to come.

14.text: He shall glorify me: for he shall take of mine, and shall declare it unto you.

15.text: All things whatsoever the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he taketh of mine, and shall declare it unto you.

16.text: A little while, and ye behold me no more; and again a little while, and ye shall see me.

19.text: Jesus perceived that they were desirous to ask him, and he said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, A little while, and ye behold me not, and again a little while, and ye shall see me?

20.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, that ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

21.text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but when she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for the joy that a man is born into the world.

22.text: And ye therefore now have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no one taketh away from you.

23.text: And in that day ye shall ask me no question. Verily, verily, I say unto you, If ye shall ask anything of the Father, he will give it you in my name.

24.text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be made full.

25.text: These things have I spoken unto you in dark sayings: the hour cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in dark sayings, but shall tell you plainly of the Father.

26.text: In that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you;

27.text: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from the Father.

28.text: I came out from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go unto the Father.

31.text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

32.text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

33.text: These things have I spoken unto you, that in me ye may have peace. In the world ye have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

1.text: These things spake Jesus; and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that the Son may glorify thee:

2.text: even as thou gavest him authority over all flesh, that to all whom thou hast given him, he should give eternal life.

3.text: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.

4.text: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.

5.text: And now, Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

6.text: I manifested thy name unto the men whom thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

7.text: Now they know that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are from thee:

8.text: for the words which thou gavest me I have given unto them; and they received them, and knew of a truth that I came forth from thee, and they believed that thou didst send me.

9.text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for those whom thou hast given me; for they are thine:

10.text: and all things that are mine are thine, and thine are mine: and I am glorified in them.

11.text: And I am no more in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

12.text: While I was with them, I kept them in thy name which thou hast given me: and I guarded them, and not one of them perished, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

13.text: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

14.text: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

15.text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them from the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil one.

16.text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

17.text: Sanctify them in the truth: thy word is truth.

18.text: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.

19.text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

20.text: Neither for these only do I pray, but for them also that believe on me through their word;

21.text: that they may all be one; even as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be in us: that the world may believe that thou didst send me.

22.text: And the glory which thou hast given me I have given unto them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

23.text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that thou didst send me, and lovedst them, even as thou lovedst me.

24.text: Father, I desire that they also whom thou hast given me be with me where I am, that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

25.text: O righteous Father, the world knew thee not, but I knew thee; and these knew that thou didst send me;

26.text: and I made known unto them thy name, and will make it known; that the love wherewith thou lovedst me may be in them, and I in them.

4.text: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were coming upon him, went forth, and saith unto them, Whom seek ye?

5.text: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

6.text: When therefore he said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

7.text: Again therefore he asked them, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

8.text: Jesus answered, I told you that I am he; if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

11.text: Jesus therefore said unto Peter, Put up the sword into the sheath: the cup which the Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

20.text: Jesus answered him, I have spoken openly to the world; I ever taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where all the Jews come together; and in secret spake I nothing.

21.text: Why askest thou me? ask them that have heard me, what I spake unto them: behold, these know the things which I said.

23.text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

34.text: Jesus answered, Sayest thou this of thyself, or did others tell it thee concerning me?

36.text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

37.text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end have I been born, and to this end am I come into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

11.text: Jesus answered him, Thou wouldest have no power against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath greater sin.

26.text: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold, thy son!

27.text: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold, thy mother! And from that hour the disciple took her unto his own home.

28.text: After this Jesus, knowing that all things are now finished, that the scripture might be accomplished, saith, I thirst.

30.text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
